summary: 53-year-old man who texted family he was lost in the mountains was found dead ~1.8 miles west of Fox Creek Road after a ~105-person multi-day ground search.
location: Near Fox Creek Road, west of Glen Haven
notes: Jerry Allbright, 53, of Glen Haven; walked away from home Friday evening (Apr 14), texted family Saturday morning that he was lost; ground crew found his body Monday evening in steep terrain with obstructions and water crossings; recovery completed the next morning (~3 hrs); search involved ~105 people, 11 dog teams, drone and fixed-wing aircraft; foul play not suspected.
